author: Stacey Ward
content:
An amazing group of people right from the very beginning excellent communication and always kept you well updated I also must add they was very excellent and understanding especially with my last minute changes and very happy to help would defo recommend these for any occasion you may have and my daughter and all her friends lover the jungle castle with slide and the Diddy cars which are well worth a hire for her 7th bday
Thanks for a brilliant day and brilliant service
